selection_process: The selection process consists of two primary stages:
First Stage: Written Examination Second Stage: Skill Test

Candidates shortlisted from the written exam will be called for the skill test in a 1:10 ratio per post. A category-wise waiting list valid for up to one year will also be prepared based on skill test scores.

exam_pattern.details: Written Examination: The written test comprises 25 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 2 marks each, totaling 50 marks. The duration of the exam is 45 minutes. Subjects covered include General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mathematics, and General Mental Ability. | Skill Test: The skill test carries 250 marks with a time limit of 10 minutes. Candidates are required to type a passage of approximately 250 words accurately on a computer using Ubuntu Linux system, LibreOffice, and Unicode Font (Mangal etc.). 1 mark is deducted for each omitted word and error/mistake. Formatting settings such as headings, bold text, paragraphs, and underlining are also treated as errors.

how_to_apply: Download the official notification and application form format from the official website www.dcourts.gov.in/korba.
Fill out the prescribed application form clearly with all required personal and educational details.
Affix a self-attested recent passport-size color photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates, technical qualifications, age proof (Matriculation marksheet), category certificate, and domicile certificate.
Enclose self-signed photocopies of identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Voter ID Card.
If employed in government or semi-government service, attach a self-attested copy of the No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the competent authority.
Write the name of the post applied for and category clearly on the top of the envelope containing the application.
Send the completed application form exclusively by post to reach the office of the District and Sessions Judge Korba on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time or through modes other than post will be rejected. Incomplete applications or applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post, clearly superscribed on respective envelopes. Original identity proofs and documents must be produced during the skill test or verification stages. Selected candidates will undergo a 3-year probation period and must pass medical fitness standards prescribed by the Medical Board. Any attempt to influence the selection process directly or indirectly will lead to immediate disqualification and legal action.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for the Assistant Grade-3 post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form by post is 30 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Grade-3?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a graduation degree, a 1-year computer diploma from a recognized board/university, knowledge of Hindi and English typing, and familiarity with the Chhattisgarh local dialect.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as on 1 January 2026, with an upper age limit of 40 years for Chhattisgarh local residents, extendable up to 45 years with all relaxations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline exclusively through post to the designated office address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written examination followed by a skill test (typing test).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary scale for Assistant Grade-3?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of 19500-62000 under Pay Level-4.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any probation period after selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of three years.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of educational and technical certificates, marksheets, age proof, caste and domicile certificates, identity proofs like Aadhaar card, and NOC if employed.
